data.recordings_layout: Recordings in the media tile (applies to all receivers)
data.media_show_channels: Show channels in the media browser

data_description.recording_image_sources: Select multiple sources, or clear all to disable thumbnails. Priority: custom URL, TMDB, OMDb, snapshot. Only selected Internet sources receive the recording title.
data_description.recording_snapshot_minutes: Default: 10 minutes. Shorter completed recordings use their midpoint. Does not start playback.
data_description.recording_image_url: Direct JPEG, PNG or WebP URL. Placeholders in braces: title, filename, channel. Values are URL-encoded.
data_description.media_show_channels: Optional channel folder in both media views; disabled by default. Channel images use available picons.
data_description.media_channel_bouquet: Select a channel group by name. Empty: follow the bouquet currently selected for Source.
data_description.external_playback: Play live TV and TS recordings through Home Assistant. Automatic mode prefers compatible receiver streams; conversion requires FFmpeg and CPU capacity. Multiple simultaneous streams are supported.
data_description.stream_port: Receiver streaming port, usually 8001. Recordings still use the OpenWebif port.
data_description.stream_https: Enable only if the streaming port supports HTTPS. Uses the saved certificate verification and credentials.
data_description.stream_mode: Automatic uses suitable receiver output and copies compatible video and audio. Compatibility always converts to 720p/H.264 and AAC.
data_description.stream_limit: Per receiver; default 5, 0 = unlimited. Viewers of the same live channel share a stream. Each recording playback counts separately. Stopped streams are released after two minutes without requests.

init.title: Receiver options

stream_disabled.message: Enable “Playback on other devices” in the integration options.

timer_unconfirmed.message: The timer action may have taken effect but was not clearly confirmed. It will not be retried automatically. Check the timer in OpenWebif before running the action again.

recording_not_live.message: Select a live channel on the awake receiver. This action is unavailable in standby or during file playback.

recording_no_epg.message: No valid current EPG programme is available for this channel. No recording was started.

timer_edit_data.message: Timer data is incomplete or the new times are invalid. No edit was sent. Check the timer in OpenWebif.

timer_edit_missing.message: The existing timer identity is no longer unique or present. Reread its service reference, start and end in OpenWebif.

timer_edit_scope.message: This edit affects an entire series. Explicitly select Entire series. Individual occurrences cannot be edited here.

timer_edit_rejected.message: The receiver rejected the edit. Timer values may still have changed. Check the refreshed list in OpenWebif.

timer_conflict.message: The receiver reports timer conflicts: {conflicts}. The action was rejected; edits may still have changed values. Check OpenWebif.

invalid_action_choice.message: Choose exactly one channel input: channel selection or manual reference. Choices must belong to the selected receiver. Use only one of the two recording directory fields.

epg_data.message: The receiver did not return a usable EPG list. Check OpenWebif.

epg_changed.message: The EPG result is missing, expired or changed. Search again; no timer was created.

epg_timer_ambiguous.message: This channel has an overlapping or repeated timer whose coverage is uncertain. Check receiver timers; no additional timer was created.

recording_data.message: The receiver did not return a fully readable recording catalog. Please reload.

recording_path.message: The recording path is ambiguous or unsuitable.

recording_destination.message: Destination unavailable. Choose an existing recording directory on this receiver.

recording_busy.message: The selected recording is being recorded, prepared, played or streamed. Stop its use first.

recording_pending.message: A recording operation remains unconfirmed. Check its status; do not repeat it.

recording_confirm.message: Explicitly confirm deletion, which may be permanent.

recording_stale.message: The recording changed or no longer exists. Reload the list and select it again.

recording_collision.message: The destination already contains a recording with the same base name. Nothing is overwritten.

recording_activity_unknown.message: An active recording or playback cannot be reliably matched to a file. Check receiver state.

snapshot_binary.title: FFmpeg is missing for recording thumbnails
snapshot_binary.description: Recording thumbnails for {receiver} use snapshots, but the FFmpeg executable was not found. Install FFmpeg in the Home Assistant runtime or correct its configured path, then reload Enigma2 Connect. Alternatively, open Receiver settings and deselect **Snapshot from recording** or choose another source. Receiver controls remain available.
